Phase 15 is in positional-phase15.tar.gz. It unpacks at the repository root and holds only the 7 changed or new files. Nothing needs deleting.

This was built against your latest dump (commit d46f71f4, which includes 14b). I could only check the new files for syntax with kotlinc here, because the Android and Maven libraries aren’t reachable from my sandbox. Real compilation and the tests happen in CI.

What changed:

SettingsViewModel (new):
Settings screen state now comes from this view model and is collected with collectAsStateWithLifecycle.
The state is rebuilt only when one of the 11 settings preferences changes, or on resume and after a permission result, which covers the permission banner and app icon.
Before, any preference change at all rebuilt the state and queried all 12 launcher icon aliases from the package manager, on the main thread.
Settings panel: it no longer writes preferences itself. It keeps only the actions that need the activity: the permission request, opening app settings, recreating the activity for theme, corner, language and accent changes, the keep-screen-on window flag, navigation and links.
LevelViewModel (new): the square or round style is now a flow that follows the preference. The Level panel keeps only the gravity sensor and the tilt.
MainPreferences: five preference keys are now public so the view model can watch them.
Tests: a new SettingsViewModelTest covers the theme mode and the corner radius conversion.
README: phase 15 is marked done, and phase 16 is listed as next: the remaining panels’ preference listeners become view model flows.
Worth checking on the Nord:

Toggle units, coordinate format and map source in Settings. Each should update straight away.
Change the app icon. The selection should stick.
Deny location permission, then grant it from app settings. The banner should disappear when you return.
Toggle the level style.
Please re-run export.sh and upload the new dump before phase 16.
